name: @dev-mainsequence/codex-plugin
description: MainSequence for Codex: durable agent messaging in native chat, Agents and Tools discovery, developer commands and conversational MCPs

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.cjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-codex.cjs
scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck && npm test && node scripts/check-release.cjs && node scripts/check-docs.cjs && node scripts/pack-codex.cjs && npm pack --ignore-scripts --pack-destination artifacts && npm run verify:package
